Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & rotating time slots

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet you and Tom today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery:
- Business need: reduce per-query latency and cost for Acme's chat assistant across EU and US customers while keeping logs in your VPC.
- Primary success metrics: median token latency < 250ms, 30% cost reduction vs current infra, and retention of PII controls.
- Next step: technical deep dive + demo of Redwood Dedicated and routing/fallback behavior (expected 60 min).

To make scheduling easier across your teams in the US and EU (and to include our APAC engineers later), we recommend a rotating set of time slots so the same people don't always have to join early/late. Proposed recurring rotation (we can pilot for 3 meetings):
1) US-friendly: 9:30 AM PT / 12:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM BST
2) EU-friendly: 11:00 AM BST / 6:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM SGT
3) APAC-friendly: 10:00 AM SGT / 6:00 PM BST / 1:00 PM PT

Please let us know which of these would work for you and Tom next week — we can send calendar invites with Zoom links and attach the short discovery recap.

I've attached a 1-pager recap and a sample rotating-slots .ics. Marissa will join the technical deep dive and Ethan will cover deployment/consumption patterns.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
